facts.text: Whittier College and its host city were named in honor of John Greenleaf Whittier, a prominent Quaker, poet, and abolitionist leader.

sources.title: Whittier College History
sources.quote: Both the town and the College were named in honor of John Greenleaf Whittier, prominent Quaker, poet, and leader in the abolitionist movement.

facts.text: Through the Whittier Scholars Program, students have the opportunity to design their own individualized major.

sources.title: Whittier Scholars Program
sources.quote: The Whittier Scholars Program offers students the opportunity to design their own major, tailored just for them.
